done_when: The guide tells agents to score every option they propose, every plan and every blocking review finding on value, effort and risk from 1 to 5, marked as judgement and not measurement, ranked and shown as a table; stop questions show each finding's scores; the README explains how Forge does this with worked examples; new and upgraded repos get the guide
why: Options, review findings and plans reach the owner as long lists with no sense of which matter most; scoring each on value, effort and risk makes the choice quick
